name: tradingview
description: TradingView Desktop integration for real-time prices, DCF price alerts, and chart snapshots. Calls TradingView Desktop CLI via CDP — requires Desktop running with --remote-debugging-port=9222. Falls back to yfinance when unavailable.
author: InvestmentToolkit

external_dependencies.name: tradingview-mcp-cli
external_dependencies.purpose: Node.js CLI that connects to TradingView Desktop via CDP

external_dependencies.name: target-portfolio-json
external_dependencies.purpose: Target weights and thesis for all holdings

external_dependencies.name: projections-dir
external_dependencies.purpose: DCF projection JSONs — source of bear/base/bull alert prices
